Studied: Capture.description:
🪢 You trained in restraint: police arrest techniques from a relative, a security guard course or a hero-prep school's capture drills.

🌱 You control an arm, apply cuffs, zip ties or capture tape, and keep a subdued person breathing and secured.
⚠️ A struggling Quirk user, a heteromorph with unusual limbs or a Quirk that slips bindings can still break free.
⚖️ Arrests belong to the police and licensed heroes. You may hold someone caught in the act only until the police arrive.
🏫 It shows in quick hands and a reflex to check a restrained person's breathing.

📈 Grants: Capture +15
Studied: Capture.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has trained to restrain people safely: controlling an arm, applying cuffs and zip ties, wrapping capture tape, positioning a subdued person so they can breathe and keeping them secured. They know a careless restraint injures. Prior study, not mastery: a struggling Quirk user, a heteromorph with unusual limbs or someone whose Quirk slips bindings will still break free. Not a license: arrests belong to the police and licensed heroes; a private person may hold someone caught in the act only until the police arrive and must hand them over at once. It shows in quick hands and a reflex to check a restrained person's breathing.
